headline: Inactives are posted for the 10 AM games. Robinson, Downs and the Jets D are all active, so no swaps. Still add a kicker before 10:00 AM.
alerts: Sun 8:45 AM: Inactives are out for the 10 AM games. Brian Robinson, Josh Downs and the Jets D are all active. No swaps needed.
No kicker shows on your tracked roster. Use the open spot (or drop Hockenson) to add one before Sun 10:00 AM. Harrison Mevis (Rams, 1:05 PM) is a good fit.
Jalen Hurts is on IR (calf blood clot). Move him to an IR slot if your league has one. Start Brissett at QB.
Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive, which should push a few more targets to Downs.
Patriots WR A.J. Brown is active against the Jets D, a small downgrade for the Jets.
Sun 10:00 AM: Robinson, Downs and Jets D lock. 1:05 PM: Brissett. 1:25 PM: Mitchell. 5:20 PM: Lloyd, Golden, Ferguson. Mon 5:15 PM: McLaurin.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so the roster is from an earlier run. Confirm your starters in the app.

ARI.note: At Rams Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Rams -12.5, total 51.5, Arizona about 19.5 implied. RB Jeremiyah Love is out.

PHI.note: Vs. Carolina Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Hurts went on IR Saturday, Tanner McKee starts. Barkley is out. Panthers -3, total 39.5.

ATL.note: Vs. Chicago Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Bears -1.5, total 52.5, Falcons about 25.5 implied. Penix starts, and the Bears reportedly plan to start Caleb Williams.

LAC.note: At Kansas City Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Chiefs -7.5, total 41.5, Chargers about 17 implied. Tre Harris, Joe Alt and Derwin James are out.

GB.note: Vs. Dallas Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. Packers -1.5, total 53.5, about 27.5 implied. Skyy Moore is out.

DAL.note: At Green Bay Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. Lamb practiced fully all week. CB Cobie Durant is out.

WAS.note: At San Francisco Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. 49ers -7.5, total 52.5. McLaurin has no designation, Diggs is questionable, Croskey-Merritt is out.

IND.note: Vs. Tennessee Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Colts -7, total 44.5, about 26 implied. Downs is off the report, TE Tyler Warren is questionable.

NYJ.note: At New England Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Patriots -7.5, total 43.5. Hall is out.

JAX.note: Vs. Houston in London, Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific. Jaguars -2.5, total 42.5. Inactives posted, Texans RB David Montgomery is out. No rostered players.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: Props: 242.5 passing yards, 1.5 TD with the over at +140, 36.5 attempts. About 14.5 points with about 1 INT.
Arizona is a 12.5-point underdog at the Rams, total 51.5, so pass volume should stay high.
RB Jeremiyah Love is out, which can push even more of the offense through the air.
Your only healthy QB this week with Hurts out. Kickoff Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific.
